subject: english
description: Past year questions on Synonyms, Antonyms, Word Formation, Idioms

questions.question: Write one synonym and one antonym each for: 'abundant', 'brave', 'ancient'.
questions.solution:
**Abundant:** Synonym — plentiful | Antonym — scarce
**Brave:** Synonym — courageous | Antonym — cowardly
**Ancient:** Synonym — old/ancient | Antonym — modern/new
questions.knowledgeNote: Building vocabulary: Read widely, note new words, use flashcards, practice in sentences.

questions.question:
Write the meaning of the following idioms:
(a) 'Break the ice' (b) 'A blessing in disguise' (c) 'Cost an arm and a leg'
questions.solution:
(a) **Break the ice** — To initiate conversation in a social setting; to overcome shyness.
(b) **A blessing in disguise** — Something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good.
(c) **Cost an arm and a leg** — To be extremely expensive.
questions.knowledgeNote: Idioms are fixed expressions whose meanings cannot be deduced from individual words. Learn them in context.
